name: Rishikesh
intro: Luxury wellness resorts along the sacred Ganges offering yoga, meditation, river rafting, and outdoor executive development sessions.
access: Roughly five and a half hours by road from Delhi, or fly to Dehradun.
highlights: Rafting and river-camp formats produce the kind of shared challenge that team-building workshops only simulate.
Riverside properties handle a mixed programme well: a working morning, an activity afternoon, a bonfire evening.
Drivable from Delhi, so the budget goes into the programme rather than air fares.
planning_note: Rafting is suspended during the monsoon and river conditions vary by season. Confirm the activity window before promising it in an itinerary.
